instruction: Fix `tokenize` in `rpncalc/tokenizer.py` so it splits on any whitespace, not just single spaces. The current code splits on a single space character, so runs of spaces, tabs, or newlines leave empty tokens or fail to split.
gold_patch:
diff --git a/rpncalc/tokenizer.py b/rpncalc/tokenizer.py
--- a/rpncalc/tokenizer.py
+++ b/rpncalc/tokenizer.py
@@ -17,4 +17,4 @@
 
 def tokenize(expression: str) -> list[str]:
     """Split ``expression`` into whitespace-delimited tokens."""
-    return expression.split(" ")
+    return expression.split()
